title: MONROE CAPITAL Corp 8-K Filing — Asset Sale and Merger with Horizon Technology Finance
summary: Monroe Capital Corporation (MRCC) completed the sale of its investment assets to Monroe Capital Income Plus Corporation (MCIP) for approximately $335.3 million on April 14, 2026, and immediately completed its previously announced merger with Horizon Technology Finance Corporation (HRZN). MRCC stockholders received 0.9402 shares of HRZN common stock per share, with approximately 20.37 million HRZN shares issued in total. The company withdrew its BDC election upon merger completion.
key_points: Asset Sale: Monroe Capital Corporation sold all investment assets to MCIP for ~$335.3 million (fair value as of April 11, 2026)
Merger: MRCC merged with Horizon Technology Finance Corporation (HRZN) effective April 14, 2026
Exchange ratio: MRCC stockholders received 0.9402 shares of HRZN common stock per share
Approximately 20,370,693 shares of HRZN stock issued to MRCC stockholders
Company repaid all amounts under ING Facility and terminated it in connection with the transaction
MRCC withdrew its election to be treated as a BDC per Section 54(c) of the Investment Company Act of 1940
